description: Resolve a production-style incident where a critical user flow is broken, then document the root cause and prevention steps.
requirements: Repository should describe the incident scenario in README.md, issue notes or commit message
Fix should restore the broken critical flow such as login, checkout, profile update or data sync
Repository should include a regression test or verification checklist for the incident
Fix should include meaningful logging, error handling or monitoring improvement where appropriate
Root cause and prevention notes should be documented
No unrelated large refactor should be mixed into the incident fix
title: Fix Production Incident
